label: late original-phase first occurrence of j/0/n/f/r/e/h/u (esp. sequences starting v/3/l/d)
explanation: Fires almost entirely during the original (input) phase (94% of mass), with a small tail on the <DEL> step and essentially never in the copy phase or at t=0. Rate rises with position (orig_idx 7-8 have 6-13x lift) and with L (L=9 holds 48% of mass). Strongly prefers first occurrences of a specific token set (j, 0, n, f, r, e, h, u; j and 0 strongest) and sequences whose first token is v, 3, l or d. Activations often extend over several consecutive late input steps and into <DEL>. Even the best predicate is imprecise (dev P~0.23, R~0.44, mass recall ~0.53); firing seems to depend on accumulated hidden-state context that these variables do not capture. Does not fire on repeated tokens (in_first=0 has 0.2x lift) or on tokens such as b, g, z, i.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=1: j; t=2: j, 0, f, r; t=8: j, 0, f, n) and the first original token (most: v, 3, l, d, s, m; least: h, n, r, j); timing cues that raise it most: L=9 & t=8, L=8 & t=7, L=7 & t=10.
